To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Planar transformer design is suitable to reduce self-capacitancies and to reduce the size of the transformer for the high voltage flyback applications.
we developed a methodology for design and analysis of Planar Transformer with reduced self-capacitancy.
the self-capacitive effects of the PT are significantly reduced as compared with conventional wire wound transformer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a design methodology for Planars Transformer for high voltage flyback circuits with low profile, low self-capacitanace and better insulation.
the design of the planar transformer with low self-capacity used in high voltage charging circuit.
the design methodology of Planar Transformer for HV flyback charging circuits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the FEM is capable of predicting self-capacitancies in between the layers of the Planar transformer with larger turns on the Secondary side.
the PT design has the potential to reduce the self-capacitive parasitics of a transformer and hence can be used in high voltage applications.
PT is a better choice for high voltage transformer with minimum self capacitance and low profile.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed a PT with minimum self-capacity and low profile which can be used in HV flyback charging circuits.
the PT with low self-capacity can be implemented in flyback HV charging circuits for capacitive loads.
we have developed an analytical method for self-capacitancemodelling of Planar Transformer with larger number of turns and the results are validated with FRA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PT has a significant reduction in self-capacitancy as compared to CWT.
the PT can be implemented for high voltage flyback circuits with low self-capacity and low profile.
the FEM can be used for design of PT with low self-capacity for high voltage flyback applications.
